column4: IronCalc shows INDEX(...) as @INDEX(...) (implicit-intersection marker added to the formula text); value is right

follows from the 3-D ref import gap below: IronCalc computes #ERROR! (not an OOXML error code), so the formula is saved without a cached value and fullCalcOnLoad is set; Excel/LibreOffice recompute 776.25, calamine reads the empty cache
3-D references (SUM(Jan:Mar!B2:B4)) are not supported: evaluates to #ERROR! instead of 776.25
locale-tagged currency format [$Rp-421]#,##0 displays #VALUE!
built-in numFmtId 14 is shown as mm-dd-yy (08-17-25) instead of Excel's m/d/yyyy for en-US
date-time 14:30 displays 14:29 (seconds truncated after float rounding)
fraction formats (# ?/?) are not supported
format "0" rounds 1234.5 to 1234 (Excel rounds half away from zero: 1235)
